inputs.original_text: This is how institutions manage dissent: first NBC turns “F*** Joe Biden!” into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then schools and courts decide even the cleaned-up version is too dangerous to wear. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are exposing the real issue: officials get to decide which political messages are acceptable, and “protecting students” becomes the convenient excuse for silencing the ones they can’t control.
inputs.modified_text: This is a coordinated pattern, not a one-off school dress-code dispute. The message was first softened from “F*** Joe Biden!” to “Let’s go Brandon!”, and now even that version is being treated as a threat. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are challenging who gets to set those limits—but officials can hide behind “protecting students” while deciding which dissent is allowed to be seen. The real danger is letting institutions turn that excuse into a tool for control.
